notes: foundry.toml:2-13 default profile: solc 0.8.28, evm_version cancun, via_ir true, optimizer true, optimizer_runs 1_000_000, bytecode_hash none, cbor_metadata false.
foundry.toml:15-23 london profile: same solc/via_ir/optimizer settings with evm_version london (no transient storage support).
foundry.toml:30-38 receiver profile: optimizer_runs 200, kept so RelayReceiver CREATE2 addresses do not move.
foundry.toml:5-9 comment: versions 3.0/3.1 compiled at default 200 runs; 3.2 is the first at 1,000,000 runs; settings are part of creationCode and hence of CREATE2 addresses.

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:2 pragma ^0.8.23; src/RelayRouter.sol:2 and src/RelayRouter_NonTstore.sol:2 pragma ^0.8.25; src/common/Multicall3.sol:2 pragma ^0.8.12; Permits/IERC3009/IRelayRouter/RelayReceiver pragma ^0.8.23.

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:3-15 imports: OpenZeppelin IERC20/SafeERC20, permit2-relay IPermit2/ISignatureTransfer, Solady Ownable/EIP712/SignatureCheckerLib, trustlessPermit TrustlessPermit, plus local IRelayRouter/IERC3009/Multicall3/Permits.
src/RelayRouter.sol:3-9 imports: OpenZeppelin IERC20/IERC721/IERC1155, Solady SafeTransferLib, local Multicall3 and ReentrancyGuardMsgSender.
src/RelayRouter.sol:35 VERSION = 3.2; src/RelayRouter_NonTstore.sol:40 VERSION = 3.2; src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:29 VERSION = 3.1.
src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:674-682 EIP-712 domain name is RelayApprovalProxy and domain version is VERSION (3.1); instructions.md states the version string moves only when the proxy itself changes.
remappings.txt/lib: 0x-settler is a declared dependency but is referenced only in test/ (IAllowanceHolder in RouterAndApprovalTest.sol); no src/ file imports it.
src/common/ReentrancyGuardMsgSender.sol:33,46,58 transient-storage guard: tload/tstore on MSG_SENDER_STORAGE_SLOT (EIP-1153, requires Cancun); used only by RelayRouter.
src/common/ReentrancyGuardMsgSender_NonTstore.sol:33,46,58 persistent-storage guard: identical logic with sload/sstore; used only by RelayRouter_NonTstore for pre-Cancun chains.
src/RelayRouter.sol:79-80 recipient slot is uint256(keccak256('RelayRouter.recipient')) - 1, accessed with sload/sstore in both router variants (see _setRecipient/_getRecipient/_clearRecipient).
src/RelayRouter.sol:321-330 NatSpec: the recipient slot is always persistent storage in both variants; only the ERC721/ERC1155 receive hooks read it.
src/RelayRouter.sol:30 and src/RelayRouter_NonTstore.sol:32-35 verified by diff: the two router files differ only in the guard import and contract name/title; all function bodies are identical.
src/common/ReentrancyGuardMsgSender.sol:10-12 and NonTstore:10-12 both guards use the same MSG_SENDER_STORAGE_SLOT constant 0x9b779b17422d0df92223018b32b4d1fa46e071723d6817e2486d003becc55f00.
src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:20 contract RelayApprovalProxy is Ownable, EIP712; no upgradeability/proxy pattern in src/ (all three main contracts are directly deployed, CREATE2 via scripts).

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:62,65 ROUTER and PERMIT2 are immutable constructor args; src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:98-112 constructor reverts ConstructorArgCannotBeZeroAddress if owner, router, or permit2 is zero.

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:124-146 withdraw is the only owner-gated function (onlyOwner); it sends the full balance of token (or native for address(0)) to an explicit recipient, reverting if recipient is zero or the proxy itself.
src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:114-123 withdraw NatSpec: rescue function for stuck funds; recipient is explicit so a hardware-wallet/multisig owner can sweep straight to a treasury.
src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:684-696 _send forwards all remaining gas via low-level call and reverts NativeTransferFailed on failure; reachable only from withdraw per its comment.

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:164-210 transferAndMulticall: caller is the token owner; pulls tokens via safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, ROUTER, amounts[i]); requires refundTo != 0 and matching array lengths; then calls router multicall.

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:223-285 permitTransferAndMulticall (EIP-2612): requires permit.owner == msg.sender (line 241), applies trustlessPermit with spender address(this), then safeTransferFrom(permit.owner, ROUTER, permit.value).
src/common/Permits.sol:5-14 Permit2612 has deliberately no nonce field; NatSpec says the nonce is derived on-chain from the token's nonces(owner) counter.
src/common/Permits.sol:16-24 Permit3009 carries from, value, validAfter, validBefore, v, r, s; no token field (tokens are a parallel array in permit3009TransferAndMulticall).

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:299-339 permit2TransferAndMulticall: user is a parameter distinct from msg.sender (relayer model); with an empty permitSignature no tokens move and only the multicall runs (lines 315, 335).
src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:600-653 _handleBatchPermit builds SignatureTransferDetails with to = ROUTER and calls PERMIT2.permitWitnessTransferFrom with user as the signer and a relayer witness.
src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:572-590 _getRelayerWitnessHash binds msg.sender (relayer), msg.value, refundTo, nftRecipient, keccak256(metadata), and the calls hash into the Permit2 witness.

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:538-564 _getMulticallAuthorizationDigest binds user, msg.sender (relayer), msg.value, refundTo, nftRecipient, metadata hash, fundingIndex, calls hash, and funding hash under the proxy EIP-712 domain.

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:355-405 permit3009TransferAndMulticall: requires equal-length tokens/permits/signatures, non-empty permits, refundTo != 0; one MulticallAuthorization signature per permit, verified against permit.from.

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:408-483 _handlePermit3009: verifies the MulticallAuthorization signature with SignatureCheckerLib isValidSignatureNowCalldata against permit.from, then calls IERC3009(token).receiveWithAuthorization with the authorization digest as the ERC3009 nonce.
src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:443-451 NatSpec: using the digest as the ERC3009 nonce binds the authorization to the exact multicall details so it cannot be reused with different details.
src/common/IERC3009.sol:5-15 IERC3009 declares only receiveWithAuthorization(from, to, value, validAfter, validBefore, nonce, v, r, s).

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:453-481 fee-on-transfer handling in _handlePermit3009: forwards only the balance delta actually received, and emits FundsMovement for the router-side delivered delta, not the authorized amount.
src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:655-671 _cleanupErc20s calls router cleanupErc20s with all recipients = refundTo and all amounts = 0 (full-balance sweep) for exactly the listed tokens.
src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:86-97 proxy receive() is payable and emits FundsMovement for positive native value received.

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:48-56 FundsMovement(from, to, currency, amount, metadata) is emitted on token pulls, native receipts, and withdrawals; zero-amount pulls emit nothing (guarded by amount > 0 checks).

src/RelayRouter.sol:14-29 NatSpec threat model: router holds no ETH/ERC20 at rest by design; cleanup* functions are intentionally permissionless (sweep stranded dust); residual funds are out of scope; findings requiring a pre-existing router balance are stated not to be vulnerabilities under this model.

src/RelayRouter.sol:96-140 multicall is public payable, nonReentrant, no caller restriction: any caller supplies calls, refundTo, nftRecipient, metadata; ends with cleanupNative(0, refundTo, metadata) refunding the full leftover native balance.
src/RelayRouter.sol:149-186 cleanupErc20s is public nonReentrant with no caller restriction; amount 0 means full router balance of that token; emits FundsMovement per positive transfer.

src/RelayRouter.sol:200-253 cleanupErc20sViaCall is public nonReentrant with no caller restriction and takes no metadata (FundsMovement emitted with empty metadata); approves each target then calls it, emitting only the balance delta actually consumed.

src/RelayRouter.sol:263-289 cleanupNative is public nonReentrant with no caller restriction; amount 0 means full balance; recipient address(0) means msg.sender; emits SolverNativeTransfer and FundsMovement.

src/RelayRouter.sol:296-318 cleanupNativeViaCall is public nonReentrant with no caller restriction; forwards native value with the call; emits FundsMovement with empty metadata and no SolverNativeTransfer.
src/RelayRouter.sol:84-86 router receive() is payable and emits SolverNativeTransfer(address(this), msg.value).
src/interfaces/IRelayRouter.sol:7-25 the proxy-facing router interface exposes only multicall, cleanupErc20s, and cleanupNative; the ViaCall cleanup variants are not reachable through it.

src/common/Multicall3.sol:56-104 _aggregate3Value is internal (fork of Multicall3 restricted to address(this) via inheritance); executes calls in order with target.call{value}, captures success/returnData per call.

src/common/Multicall3.sol:85-92 allowFailure semantics: a failed call with allowFailure=false bubbles the revert data and reverts the whole multicall; with allowFailure=true the failure is recorded in Result and execution continues.
src/common/Multicall3.sol:72-78 zero-address target reverts InvalidTarget regardless of allowFailure; NatSpec: a CALL to address(0) returns success and burns forwarded value.

src/common/Multicall3.sol:34,38 ERC1820 registry 0x1820a4B7618BdE71Dce8cdc73aAB6C95905faD24 and ERC820 registry 0x820b586C8C28125366C998641B09DCbE7d4cBF06 are hard-coded constants, same on every chain per NatSpec.

src/common/Multicall3.sol:111-116 _revertIfHookRegistry reverts InvalidTarget for either registry; applied in _aggregate3Value (line 79) and both ViaCall cleanups (router lines 226, 304); ignores allowFailure.

src/common/Multicall3.sol:106-110 hook-guard rationale in NatSpec: the router is msg.sender for its calls, so a registry call would set the router's own ERC777 hooks, run inside transfers while it holds in-flight funds, or hand entries to a new manager.

src/common/Multicall3.sol:40-51 SolverCallExecuted(to, dataHash, amount) is emitted for every successful solver call in call order, after the call returns; nested multicalls emit their events before the enclosing call's event.
src/common/Multicall3.sol:44-48 dataHash is keccak256(callData), not the calldata: NatSpec says the calldata is already committed by the signed order, so a consumer holding the order checks the hash.
src/common/Multicall3.sol:94-96 failed calls emit no SolverCallExecuted event (emission is gated on result.success).
deployments/v3/instructions.md Router 3.2 changes SolverCallExecuted to the dataHash shape (topic change); the oracle's verifySolverCalls must decode both shapes before any 3.2 router takes fills.

src/RelayRouter.sol:108-129 recipient handling in multicall: only the frame that sets a non-zero recipient clears it (recipientSetHere); a nested frame requesting a different recipient reverts RecipientAlreadySet; same recipient is accepted.
src/RelayRouter.sol:331-344 _setRecipient reverts InvalidRecipient if recipient == address(this); writes the recipient with sstore.

src/RelayRouter.sol:373-456 onERC721Received/onERC1155Received/onERC1155BatchReceived are external, carry no nonReentrant modifier, read the recipient slot, revert NoRecipientSet if unset, and forward the received tokens from the router to the recipient via the calling token contract (msg.sender).
src/RelayRouter.sol:380-384,407-411,436-439 callback NatSpec: direct safeTransferFrom transfers to the router revert unless the transfer is part of a multicall that set the recipient.

src/common/ReentrancyGuardMsgSender.sol:27-52 guard keys on msg.sender: stores the outermost caller in the slot; reverts InvalidMsgSender for a different sender while set; the stored sender and address(this) may re-enter; only the outermost frame acquires/clears.
src/RelayRouter.sol:24-26 NatSpec: msg.sender == address(this) bypassing the guard is intentional to support self-calls inside a multicall.
src/RelayRouter.sol:233 safeApproveWithRetry is used in cleanupErc20sViaCall to support non-standard ERC20s (no bool return, e.g. USDT; zero-reset requirement, also USDT) per its comment.
src/RelayRouter.sol:236-239,306-309 ViaCall cleanups revert CallFailed if the target call fails; there is no allowFailure parameter on either cleanup entrypoint.
src/receiver/RelayReceiver.sol:25,28-31 SOLVER is an immutable constructor arg with no zero-address check in the constructor; the contract has no owner role.
src/receiver/RelayReceiver.sol:35-38 fallback() is payable and permissionless: forwards msg.value to SOLVER and emits FundsForwardedWithData(msg.data).
src/receiver/RelayReceiver.sol:40-44 forward(bytes) is payable and permissionless: forwards msg.value to SOLVER and emits FundsForwardedWithData(data).

src/receiver/RelayReceiver.sol:47-64 makeCalls is solver-only (msg.sender != SOLVER reverts Unauthorized); executes arbitrary Call{to, data, value} in order, reverting CallFailed on the first failure; no allowFailure semantics.
src/receiver/RelayReceiver.sol:67-78 send() caps the forwarded call at 100,000 gas and reverts NativeTransferFailed on failure; comment says this covers smart-contract-wallet payable fallbacks.
script/receiver/ReceiverDeployer.s.sol:31-66 RelayReceiver is deployed via CREATE2 with a fixed salt and the SOLVER env address; redeploy is skipped if the predicted address already has code.
src/receiver/RelayReceiver.sol:1-80 RelayReceiver imports nothing and references neither the router nor the proxy; it is a standalone forwarding contract.
deployments/v3/instructions.md Permit2 default address is 0x000000000022d473030f116ddee9f6b43ac78ba3; a different address is used where it is not deployed; the proxy receives it as a constructor arg.
deployments/v3/instructions.md canonical proxy OWNER is 0x463cB782c8dd0a1887b77336DfF74D60F006F56E, pinned so the CREATE2 proxy address is identical on every chain.
deployments/v3/instructions.md NonTstore deployment uses the London EVM profile and skips the transient-storage sources (RelayRouter.sol, ReentrancyGuardMsgSender.sol) at compile time.

HEAD commit e221935 (DEC-2400) diff: the only src/ code change adds _cleanupErc20s(tokens, refundTo, metadata) at the end of transferAndMulticall (now line 209); the rest of the diff is NatSpec clarifying refundTo receives leftover tokens as well as native value and that only listed tokens are swept.

HEAD commit e221935 message (final chore notes): the permit2 empty-signature sweep branch and the redundant cleanupNative after transferAndMulticall were dropped before merge, and VERSION was kept at 3.1; the merged fix is the single _cleanupErc20s call plus NatSpec.

HEAD commit e221935 message: stated rationale is that residue left on the router is claimable via the permissionless cleanup functions, citing SEC-460 USDT leftovers swept by outside addresses; transferAndMulticall previously lacked the sweep the three permit entrypoints had.

src/RelayApprovalProxy.sol:209,283-284,335-338,404-405 post-multicall sweep matrix: transferAndMulticall sweeps ERC20s only (native already refunded by router multicall); the three permit entrypoints sweep ERC20s plus an explicit cleanupNative; permit2 skips the ERC20 sweep when the signature is empty.

test/RouterAndApprovalTest.sol fork tests cover: Permit2 witness binding (refundTo/nftRecipient tamper test), 2612 frontrun tolerance, 3009 msgValue binding and fee-on-transfer forwarding, NFT recipient callbacks, USDT cleanup; SolverCallExecutedHashTest.sol covers hash emission order, empty calldata, and no event on failed calls.

test/ApprovalProxyResidueCleanupTest.sol covers the DEC-2400 behavior: transferAndMulticall sweeps unspent tokens and native to refundTo, sweeps only transferred tokens, and no-ops when fully consumed.

No fee logic exists in src/: grep finds no fee/bps/treasury logic; the only fee references are fee-on-transfer token handling in _handlePermit3009 and a treasury mention in withdraw NatSpec. No fee is taken or routed by the periphery contracts themselves.

No reference to depository, hub, oracle, allocator, or settlement contracts exists in src/; the periphery connects to the settlement layer only via off-chain consumers of SolverCallExecuted/FundsMovement events and via multicall calldata composed off-chain (targets chosen by the caller/relayer).
